we have developed an effective method to prepare SMN-Zein nanoparticle/BC nanofiber composite film with improved antioxidant and antibacterial activity, which can be applied in food preservation and biomedical applications.
the nanoparticle/BC nanofiber composite film has a great potential for food packaging and biomedical applications.
the SMN-Zein nanoparticle/BC nanocomposites showed improved drug release properties, antioxidant and antibacterial activity and thus can protect salmon muscle from lipid oxidation.

the development of a new type of active films with improved drug delivery properties and biological activities for food and biomedical packaging.
the development of novel BC films with improved antioxidant and antibacterial properties for the protection of salmon muscle from lipid oxidation and microbial spoilage.

the preparation of a novel silymarin/zein nanoparticles loaded bacterial cellulose nanofibers composite, which could be applied as a novel antioxidant and antibacterial food packaging material for the preservation of salmon muscle.

the nanoparticle/BC nanocomposite films have great potential in food packaging and biomedical applications.
the nanoparticle/ nanofiber composites could be a promising platform for the preparation of active BC films.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the SMN-Zein nanoparticle/BC nanofiber composite could be a promising candidate for food and biomedical packaging materials.
the nanoparticle/BC composite films could be applied in the food packaging and biomedical field.

we developed a novel method to prepare a nanoscale drug carrier for the modification of bacterial cellulose (BC)/nanofibers, which is able to improve the release rate of the drug and enhance the biological activity of the composite film, which is expected to have potential applications in the field of food packaging, drug release and biomedical applications.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the silymarin/zein nanoparticles can be adsorbed on bacterial cellulose nanofibers, which greatly changes the wettability, swelling, drug release properties, antioxidant, and antibacterial activities of the nanocomposite film.
the silymarin and zein nanoparticles can be effectively adsorped onto BC nanofiber, thus enhancing the drug release and antioxidant/ antibacterial activities of BC film.
the nanoparticle/BC nanofiber composites can be used as a promising platform for the design of active food and biomedical packaging.
